item.title: Note 1
item.description:
Notes No. 1
A system is judged over hundreds of trades. Never over one.
A single result says almost nothing about the quality of a decision. Variance dominates in the short run, and only a large sample separates edge from luck. The process is evaluated on its long-run distribution of outcomes, not on yesterday.
Not investment advice.
#algorithmictrading #quantitativetrading #riskmanagement
